subject: The 2AM discovery from 10,000 couples
preview_text: We analyzed 10,000 couples and found a single habit that keeps the spark alive — and it's not what you think.
body_paragraphs: Here's something we found after digging through 10,000 couples using SoulPlan: the ones who keep the spark alive past the six-month mark all do one thing differently — they plan one date per week without talking about it. No "What do you want to do?" No back-and-forth. Just a single tap, and it's done.

We expected the secret to be more effort, more creativity, more time. Instead, it was less — less planning fatigue, less decision drain, less of that invisible weight that makes routine feel like a slow goodbye. The couples who thrived didn't have better ideas; they just had a faster way to act on them.

That's exactly why we built Tonight's Date. It's the single AI-picked card on your home screen — tap a mood (cozy, adventurous, playful, healing) and your date is planned in 30 seconds. Your partner gets a full-screen 'thought of you tonight' moment, not a bare notification. It's the gesture that costs nothing but means everything.

Open SoulPlan now, tap Tonight's Date, and pick a mood. That's it. One move, and tonight matters. P.S. The couples who use it in their first 24 hours plan 4x more dates over the next month — so don't let this moment slip.
